messages:
Aria L.: Low-key idea — "quiet films + single soundtrack" night? Everyone brings a short (<=20min) film and one song that pairs with it. Keep it chill, no pressure.
Marcus Lee: Love that. Rec: 'The Answers' (short) + 'Holocene' by Bon Iver — mellow and reflective.
Zoe Kim: I'm in. Rec: 'Piper' (Pixar short) + 'Here Comes The Sun' acoustic cover — cute and soothing.
Lila G.: I can do an experimental pick: 'The Fall of the House of Usher' (short collage) + 'Atmospheres' by Brian Eno — ambient pair.
Ravi S.: Rec: 'Stutterer' (short) + 'Quiet' by John Legend? maybe too on-the-nose but fits the mood.
Ben (intern): New-to-me picks! I can bring 'World of Tomorrow' if backups needed. Also snacks: tea + biscotti?
Aria L.: Plan: Friday 8pm in the lounge, projector on low brightness, headphones available. Keep total under 90min.
polly-bot: Poll created: "Which vibe for Friday's quiet film night?" Options: Gentle/heartfelt / Ambient/experimental / Family-friendly / Mixed bag
Marcus Lee: Voted Ambient/experimental. I'll bring a small speaker and an extension cable.
Zoe Kim: Voted Family-friendly. Also can we make sure captions are available for non-English shorts?
Lila G.: Voted Ambient/experimental. Note: some experimental shorts have no dialogue, captions not needed but helpful for context.
Ravi S.: Voted Mixed bag. Snacks: tea sounds perfect. I'll bring a sampler pack.
Aria L.: Poll closes Thu 6pm. If Mixed bag wins we'll randomize picks and do a short 2-min ‘why this song’ after each film. No spoilers in thread pls. Thanks y'all — cozy vibes only :sparkles:
